config.population: days in both inputs with parsed final-product occurrence time (parse-ok); missing-occurrence days excluded and counted, with an as-early sensitivity
config.cutoff_procedure: per station: modal first_asof_hour among non-null preliminary AS-OF hours; gate on modal share -- PREREG Sec 2
config.late_day: final max occurrence hour >= station cutoff (quantized at-or-after)
config.estimands: L_s, p_late_s, p_early_s, R_s, sep_s = p_late - p_early (Newcombe 95%), AF_s = (R_s - p_early_s)/R_s (point), 4-station rank agreement, pairwise Kitagawa decomposition -- PREREG Sec 3
config.ci_method: Wilson (rates) / Newcombe (differences), no continuity correction, two-sided 95%, z = 1.959963984540054
config.decision_criteria: per evaluation station: sep strong (L > 0.10) / positive (L > 0) / straddle / inverted (U < 0); early floor (Wilson upper of p_early < 0.15); AF >= 0.50 (not-strictly-less) -- PREREG Sec 5
config.decision_rule: 0) gate fails -> BLOCKED; 1) any inversion -> D; 2) both full_pass AND rank agreement -> A; 3) any positive-or-strong sep -> B; 4) otherwise -> C -- PREREG Sec 7
config.timezone: none -- local wall-clock hours from the products themselves
config.exact_arithmetic: integer counts; Decimal precision-50 bounds; 1e-12 ROUND_HALF_EVEN quantized strict comparisons; fixed-point 12-digit serialization

decision.reason: an eligibility gate failed; no interval computed
decision.interpretation: An eligibility gate failed; not a scientific outcome. See eligibility_gates.

reproducibility_verification.serialization_policy: Every non-integer decision-relevant quantity is a JSON string: Decimal quantized to 1e-12 via ROUND_HALF_EVEN, fixed-point, 12 digits -- inherited F4. Integer counts remain plain JSON integers.
